content: Yes, this project confuses me. Key struggles: 1) I assumed standard patterns (core.py) that don't exist here. 2) I tried READ on directories instead of EXPLORE. 3) The codebase IS me, but I don't have a mental map of myself. What would help: exploring caf/ systematically to understand my own structure before acting.

Honest reflection: Yes, this project confused me. I assumed standard patterns (core.py, main.py) without exploring first. The codebase is minimal - just __init__.py with version. What would help: a README or map showing structure. My error was assumption over exploration. The vault concept is elegant but I needed to discover it, not assume it.
